systems_found: University of Alaska System (UAF, UAA incl. community campuses such as Prince William Sound College, UAS)

sources.update_frequency: on request; UA notifies employees semi-annually
sources.terms: Alaska Public Records Act (AS 40.25) / AS 39.25.080; Regents' policy
sources.blocker: Not published online; requires a public records request to UA
sources.notes: UA confirms the full payroll with names and compensation is public and released routinely to requesters, so a request is likely to yield a clean bulk file. Good candidate for a records request.

sources.institution: State of Alaska executive compensation report (AS 37.05.210)
sources.system: State of Alaska, Division of Finance
sources.coverage_years: annual calendar-year reports (published end of January)
sources.institutions_covered: University of Alaska president, vice-president, campus chancellors (plus state executives)
sources.blocker: Covers only a handful of UA executives; doa.alaska.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch so format/years not verified
sources.notes: Checkbook Online (doa.alaska.gov/dof/reports/ckbkonline.html) is vendor payments >= $1,000 in Excel/PDF, not payroll; UA is not on the state checkbook payroll.

sources.institutions_covered: UAA, UAF, UAS employees (profile pages seen, e.g. UAA faculty 2023)
sources.blocker: Third-party per-person pages; no bulk download; provenance unclear
sources.notes: Suggests UA records-request data has been obtained and republished by third parties.

private_extra: None found (Alaska Pacific University publishes only IRS 990). Ilisagvik College is a tribal college; not researched.
gaps: No online person-level pay publication by University of Alaska; state open-data/checkbook does not include UA payroll. Full data available only via public records request.
notes: Treated Alaska community colleges as part of UA (UAA community campuses). doa.alaska.gov blocked automated fetch (403), so executive compensation report details come from search snippets.
